courses.title: Shamanic Breathwork Dearmoring Training
courses.description: A 20-hour hybrid training: online foundations followed by two afternoons of hands-on practice in Surry Hills, Sydney. Johnson teaches how to read breath, posture, holding patterns and emotional access in the body, and how to work with touch, acupressure, breath, movement and verbal guidance; it is open to facilitators and to people who come for their own practice.

left_out: Shamanic Spinal Sessions (https://www.johnsonchong.com/shamanic-spinal-sessions/): the page's wellbeing wording would pass (chronic tension softens, trauma held in the body), but it tells readers that clients 'doing talk-therapy for 5 or 10 years ... hit a plateau and cannot make real change' until the energy discharges, and 'You may have done the therapy ... yet your body still feels stuck'. That sets the sessions up against therapy, which is close to suggesting it in place of mental-health care; left out under the owner's 'even indirectly' note. A human may decide otherwise.
